description: This file defines a set of React components for a custom select dropdown UI, utilizing Radix UI primitives and lucide icons, with utility functions for styling.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Main wrapper component for the select primitive.

methods.name: SelectValue
methods.description: Component to display the selected value.

methods.name: SelectTrigger
methods.description: Component that triggers the dropdown menu.

methods.name: SelectContent
methods.description: Component for rendering the dropdown content.

methods.name: SelectItem
methods.description: Component representing an individual selectable item.

methods.name: SelectSeparator
methods.description: Component for separating groups of items.

methods.name: SelectScrollUpButton
methods.description: Button to scroll up in the dropdown list.

methods.name: SelectScrollDownButton
methods.description: Button to scroll down in the dropdown list.
